# Anne Shirley & Marilla Cuthbert

## Shared scenes

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is shocked to find a girl instead of the expected boy. Devastated to learn she is unwanted, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaks down in tears before introducing herself and explaining the mistake. After a solemn supper, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) puts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed in the east gable room, after which [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) debate whether to keep her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and admires the beautiful morning view from her window before being called to breakfast by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). During breakfast and while doing chores, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks exuberantly, which makes [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) nervous and highlights Matthew's quiet desire to keep the girl. Refusing to go outside to avoid falling further in love with the place, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) names Marilla's houseplant Bonny before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to take her to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) to meet Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

> During their drive to [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to recount her life story. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes growing up as an orphan, moving between overworked families who used her for childcare, and eventually being sent to the asylum. Listening to Anne's history, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) begins to feel deep pity for the girl and privately considers keeping her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER V. Anne’s History

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md) at [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) Cove to investigate how the mix-up occurred, only to find that Mrs. [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) is eager to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a domestic helper. Reluctant to leave [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with the harsh Mrs. [Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stalls and brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Later while milking cows with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to officially adopt [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), though she decides to wait until morning to break the good news to the girl.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upstairs to bed, scolding her for being untidy and discovering that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has never been taught how to say her prayers. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recites a uniquely improvised prayer at Marilla's prompting, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns to the kitchen shocked by Anne's spiritual ignorance and resolves to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that she will educate the girl properly.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) have decided to let her stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), bringing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to tears of joy. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) assigns [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to memorize the Lord's Prayer, but Anne's tendency to chatter and daydream repeatedly distracts her. After being sent to her gable room to finish memorizing, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on her new home and imagines her future in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun

> Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and makes blunt, critical remarks about Anne's red hair and appearance. In a fit of fury, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explodes at Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), insulting her back before fleeing to her bedroom. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gently reprimands [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room, ordering her to stay there until she agrees to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and gently convinces her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her room. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) agrees, informs [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and they walk over to Mrs. Lynde's house, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers a dramatically thorough apology. Touched by Anne's performance, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) forgives her and gives her hope about her hair color, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) both relieved and amused as she walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with three plain new dresses, which disappoints [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) because none of them feature puffed sleeves. The following morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home with a headache while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates her plain hat with wild flowers and attends Sunday school alone. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) a candid review of Sunday school, criticizing the dry lesson and long sermon while confessing her envy of the other girls' puffed sleeves.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for decorating her hat with wild flowers for church, but then takes her to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) immediately become fast friends and solemnize their friendship with an oath in the garden. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) treats [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to chocolate sweets, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) admits to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that she is growing fond of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes inside after playing late and excitedly tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about the upcoming Sunday-school picnic. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let her attend and promises to bake a basket of food for her, which leads [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to impulsively embrace and kiss her. As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sits down to do her patchwork sewing, she chatterboxingly describes her imaginative games with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her obsession with the picnic, while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her prized amethyst brooch.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of losing her amethyst brooch and confines her to her room until she confesses. Desperate to attend the picnic, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) fabricates a elaborate confession, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forbids her from going anyway. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) later discovers the brooch caught in her shawl, realizes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was innocent, and joyfully sends her off to the picnic.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) apologizes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for doubting her and forcing a false confession, then sends her off to the picnic. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home overjoyed after a wonderful afternoon on the lake and eating ice cream. Later that evening, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) recounts the entire incident to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), admitting her own mistake.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

> Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard and later forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to vow never to return to school. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to go back, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to seek advice from [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who suggests letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off. Later at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) catches [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imaginary future where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married and leaves her, bringing rare laughter to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) permits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for an afternoon tea party and tells her she can serve a leftover bottle of raspberry cordial. During the visit, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally serves [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) three glasses of Marilla's homemade currant wine instead, causing [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to become dizzy and sick. The next day, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) believes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deliberately got [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk and has forbidden them from playing together again.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) is furious because [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) was accidentally served currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. After [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) fails to convince Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) that it was an honest mistake, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) herself to beg for forgiveness, but Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) coldly rejects her. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in despair, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to sleep, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) tenderly kisses her after laughing over the incident with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a dramatic goodbye after Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) forbids them from playing together. Consoled by the romantic tragedy of their separation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she receives a warm welcome from her classmates and exchanges secret notes with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). Channeling her energy into her studies, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enters a fierce academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), excelling in most subjects despite struggling with geometry.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) attend a political meeting in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) spend a quiet evening at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) until [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in desperately seeking help for her dangerously ill sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md). Drawing on her past experience caring for infants, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) treats Minnie May's croup throughout the night until the doctor arrives. The next day, Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) relents on her former punishment, allowing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to resume their friendship.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) has forgiven her and invited her over to see [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rushes off in excitement and returns later in the evening to joyfully recount her wonderful afternoon, during which she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) reconciled and made taffy.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to let her attend a concert and sleep over at Diana's house. After enjoying the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed at Diana's house, accidentally jumping on Diana's formidable [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who is enraged. Learning from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) plans to leave and cancel Diana's music lessons, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels deeply remorseful for causing trouble.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> After speaking with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to confess to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her in the spare-room bed. Anne's candid apology and imaginative conversation charm the old lady, prompting her to forgive [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), extend her stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and become close friends with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on the arrival of spring and her first full year living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks her to run an errand to the Barrys' house after dark, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) admits that she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imagined the spruce grove was a "[Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood)" full of ghosts. Unimpressed by Anne's fears, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forces her to walk through the spooky woods as a lesson, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) terrified but cured of her ghost-imagining habit.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from her last day of school crying over Mr. Phillips's departure, despite her mixed feelings about him, and reports meeting Avonlea's new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. She later discusses the new minister with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), falls in love with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) as her new Sunday school teacher, and eagerly prepares to host the couple for tea at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). After preparing a layer cake and decorating the table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) watches in anticipation as Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) take their first bite of the cake, only for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to react in shock.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates the tea table beautifully for the minister and his wife, and even manages to get [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to sit with them and talk. However, disaster strikes when Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) eats the layer cake [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) made and realizes it has been flavored with anodyne liniment instead of vanilla. Mortified, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) retreats to her room in tears, but Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) kindly comforts her and turns the mistake into a lighthearted moment.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns from the post office ecstatic about being invited to tea at the manse by Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md). After worrying overnight that bad weather might ruin her day, she enjoys a wonderful afternoon at the manse and later recounts the details of her visit to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) back at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea

> During a game of dares at Diana's party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) Pye's challenge to walk the ridgepole of the kitchen roof, but she loses her balance and falls. She breaks her ankle in the fall, which causes [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to realize how deeply she cares for the girl. During her seven weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives many visitors and looks forward to returning to school to meet the new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and quickly becomes devoted to her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically describes school activities to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), including field afternoons and composition assignments. When Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) announces a Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) busies herself with rehearsals despite Marilla's skepticism and finds comfort in Matthew's quiet encouragement.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) notices that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dresses much more plainly than her peers and decides to buy her a pretty dress for Christmas. After a flustered encounter with a shop clerk, he enlists Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to help select and sew a modern dress with puffed sleeves. On Christmas morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed to receive the dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and a pair of kid slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), making her performance at the school concert an absolute success.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a gift of dainty slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) for Christmas. The local Christmas concert is a tremendous success, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivering outstanding recitations and earning high praise. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's growth and secretly express their deep pride in her performance and future potential.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> Following the excitement of the concert, school routines resume alongside minor classroom feuds. Walking to school on her thirteenth birthday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her story writing and imagination with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later establishes a story club with her friends and shares her enthusiasm and stories with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home from an Aid meeting expecting tea, but finds that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has failed to prepare it and is hiding upstairs in despair. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reveals she bought hair dye from a traveling peddler to turn her red hair black, but it turned green instead. After washing fails to remove the dye, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is forced to cut Anne's hair off, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to accept her punishment and resolve to focus on being good.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends re-enact the story of [Elaine](../character/elaine.md), floating [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) down the pond in a flat. The boat leaks and sinks, forcing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to cling to a bridge pile until [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her in a dory. After refusing Gilbert's offer of friendship, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reunites with her frantic friends and later reflects with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) on learning not to be overly romantic.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in Lover's Lane to share the news that her [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) has invited them to stay at her town home for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After getting Marilla's permission, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) travel to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) with Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), stay at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), and enjoy several days visiting the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition), taking a drive in the park, and attending a concert. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects happily on her wonderful trip and how good it is to be going back to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) bid goodbye to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who reflects fondly on Anne's pleasant company. The girls enjoy a beautiful sunset drive back home, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) warmly reunites with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) over supper.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) visited to propose organizing a special Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) preparation class for advanced students. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) excitedly agrees to join, feeling a newfound sense of ambition and purpose despite learning that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) will not be participating. Afterwards, she throws herself into her studies while continuing her silent academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets her ongoing feud with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though the two remain fierce academic rivals as the school year ends. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach next year, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to put away her textbooks for a restful summer. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), learns of Matthew's poor health, and admits to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown up.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a carefree summer outdoors on a doctor's recommendation before resuming her studies in September. Over the course of the school year, she prepares for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination under Miss Stacy's guidance and notices her own personal growth. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) reflect on how tall and mature [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) struggles with her anxieties about passing the upcoming exams.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her classmates travel to town to take the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) under Miss Stacy's guidance. After three nerve-wracking weeks of waiting back home in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the published pass list showing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the entire island with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Overjoyed, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and ends the day expressing deep gratitude for her success.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets dressed at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with Diana's help before traveling to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for a charity concert. Upon arrival, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels intimidated by the city performers and suffers a brief moment of severe stage fright. Spotting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the audience restores her determination, leading to a successful performance, an encore, and praise from the other attendees.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) with help from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), leading to an emotional farewell at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Upon arriving in town and starting her studies alongside fellow [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) students, she settles into her new boarding house. A visit from [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and Ruby reveals news of an Avery scholarship, inspiring [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with ambitious new goals for her future.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers she has won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal. After a celebratory commencement with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and catches up with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). Soon after, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) notices Matthew's failing health, learns from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about their savings being tied up in a shaky bank, and shares a quiet, peaceful evening walk with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses from sudden heart failure caused by shock after reading news of the Abbey Bank's collapse, and dies instantly. Household members and community neighbors gather to mourn him, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) try to comfort each other through their profound grief. In the following days, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confides her feelings to Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and later shares a quiet evening conversation with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns from an oculist that she must give up reading and sewing to save her failing eyesight, leading her to consider selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to give up her college scholarship to stay home, care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and teach at the local school. After learning that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school position for her benefit, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reconciles with him, and they agree to become close friends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is daydreaming on her porch when Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) furiously confronts her about her cow breaking into his oats. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) retorts about his baldness before agreeing to keep the cow secured. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discuss the encounter over tea alongside news of new residents moving into [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

> Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Stephen Irving's young son coming to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The conversation shifts to Anne's plans to start a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), which Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) cautions against, and the news that Anne's friend [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) will be teaching at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody).
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss their plans for the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) while driving home from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). Spotting a cow in Mr. Harrison's grain field, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hastily sells it to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) thinking it is her own cow, Dolly. Upon returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers Dolly is still in the pen and realizes she sold Mr. Harrison's cow by mistake, leading her to set off to apologize with a peace-offering cake.
>
> — v2 · II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to Mr. Harrison's house to confess that she accidentally sold his Jersey cow instead of her own, and offers her own cow in exchange. To her relief, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) takes the mistake good-naturedly, accepts her cake, and invites her to stay for tea. After sharing a friendly meal and clearing up the misunderstanding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to recount her successful evening.
>
> — v2 · III Mr. Harrison at Home

> On the eve of the school year, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate teaching methods, particularly whether corporal punishment is ever justified. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks home, stops to visit Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md)—who also doubts her gentle discipline approach—and goes to bed feeling anxious about her first day as a teacher. The next morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and gives her advice before she sets off.
>
> — v2 · IV Different Opinions

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her first day teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, taking note of her new students, including [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md). After school, an eccentric mother, Mrs. Donnell, visits to demand specific pronunciations and names for her children. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is cheered by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) presenting her with flowers, and later discusses the day's events with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) travel around to canvass for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), collecting subscriptions for repairs to the local hall. Along the way, they encounter various eccentric neighbors, including the pessimistic [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md) and her optimistic sister Catherine, a flustered Mr. Blair whom they help bake a cake, and the excessively neat Mrs. Theodore White.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) chat about their writing, teaching experiences with students like [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), and their ambitions for the future. Later, after [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaves, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home and discusses the possibility of temporarily taking in the orphaned Keith twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md).
>
> — v2 · VII The Pointing of Duty

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) arrives home with the orphaned Keith twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), whose contrasting behaviors quickly manifest during dinner and bedtime. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) creates chaos throughout his first week, first by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church and later by tricking [Dora](../character/dora.md) into falling into a pigpen before attempting to pump water on her. After being sent to bed, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he also placed a toad in Marilla's bed, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) frantically removes.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed out of mischief. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hastily retrieves the toad with a fire shovel and releases it in the cherry orchard before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices, after which she spots [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signaling to her from her window.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), truthfulness, and the Village Improvement Society's hall project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) finishes painting the hall, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers it was accidentally painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. Although the society members are devastated, the incident earns them widespread sympathy from the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community.
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a peaceful walk home along the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) and chats with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) before arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing. After a frantic search and dragging the well, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is confronted for his trickery and lying, eventually breaking down in remorse and promising to reform before being sent to bed.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lectures [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about telling falsehoods after he tries to test Marilla's warning about skipping prayers. Downstairs, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the joke with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and they discuss the challenges of raising the twins, admitting that despite his mischief, they both prefer [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) over the perfectly behaved [Dora](../character/dora.md).
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) detailing her amusing experiences as a teacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She shares funny anecdotes about her students' responses in class and transcribes several composition letters written by her pupils, including an overly dramatic one from [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) copied from old love letters and an imaginative letter from [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) describing his fictional rock friends.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

> In an irritable mood caused by a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has a terrible day at school, accidentally causing fireworks to explode in the classroom and later whipping [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. Returning home in despair, she confesses to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who comforts her and reassures her that everyone makes mistakes. The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is amazed to find that whipping Anthony actually won his respect, a fact later confirmed by Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks home with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), discussing community news and Marilla's improving eyesight. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learn that the twins' uncle cannot take them until autumn, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps correct Davy's funny theological misunderstandings after catching him eating plum jam. Later, at an [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, the members are appalled to learn that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a patent medicine company for advertising, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) fail to persuade him otherwise.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) corrects Davy's confused idea about heaven before sharing exciting news from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) that famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will be visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) handle the meal, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends the next day diligently cleaning the house and preparing the food with help from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md).
>
> — v2 · XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) excitedly prepare [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and a grand dinner for the guest of honor, Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). However, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) accidentally ruins the lemon pies, the guest of honor fails to arrive, and the dinner suffers from cooking mishaps and damaged property. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later receives a letter explaining Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle, making sense of the day's disappointment.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

> Following the party guests' departure, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a letter explaining that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will not be able to visit. Sitting on the porch at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss handling the broken platter, local gossip about Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), and life's disappointments before [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finish talking with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) before walking down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), where she meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to discuss their ideals and the progress of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to the house and talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her plans for the upcoming day and the return to school.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) depart for town while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays home and prepares to transfer feathers between ticks, accidentally dying her nose red in a mishap with carpet dye. [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with Mrs. Charlotte E. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), forcing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to compose herself despite her disheveled appearance. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) host the guests, and they all enjoy a pleasant dinner and a scenic walk before the visitors leave.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching, dealing with schoolroom incidents involving [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md). Later in October, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost while walking to tea in [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#east-grafton) and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the secluded home of Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Miss Lavendar warmly invites them to stay for a pretend tea party she had set up to cure her loneliness.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), her past relationship with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and the health of [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) while managing Davy's poor table manners. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) dyed feathers for an Indian headdress to keep him happy. A month later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died, leaving a trust fund for [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), which ensures they can stay permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v2 · XXII Odds and Ends

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks through the woods to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) on a winter evening to stay with Miss Lavendar while Charlotta the Fourth is away. During a cozy evening by the fire, Miss Lavendar confides the story of her past romance and falling-out with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brings Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), to meet Miss Lavendar, and the two quickly bond during a delightful visit.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

> After a newspaper item pokes fun at Uncle Abe's weather predictions, a sudden and devastating severe hail storm hits [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact day predicted. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) weather the storm at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the twins, only to find extensive damage to crops, trees, and windows across the village. Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) grieves the loss of his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) later visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as the community takes stock of the destruction.
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

> A surprising visitor arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) looking for Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) and announces that she is his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md). The news quickly spreads through [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), leading to rumors and curiosity. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who sheepishly admits he is glad his wife has returned before preparing to explain the full story of their past separation.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) separated after arguments over housecleaning, grammar, and his swearing parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), though they have now reconciled. Mrs. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) returns with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, and expresses her joy at being back with her husband. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hears the latest gossip from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before putting a sleepy [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) passes away, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to invite Mrs. [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can leave to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Upon learning of Anne's resignation from teaching, her pupils react with distress, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a quiet conversation discussing the upcoming changes and their enduring friendship.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

> At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) chat during dinner about [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and general curiosities before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). There, they are warmly welcomed by Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth for afternoon food and conversation. Afterward, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) head off to pick wild strawberries.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

> In the weeks leading up to Miss Lavendar's wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays busy helping with preparations and discussing the upcoming romantic events with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovers [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) together in the garden, learning of their secret romance. The following evening, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her engagement, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on love, change, and her own dreams for the future.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose
